name: Superior Group Of Companies
outlook:
What Superior Group Of Companies says to expect

  • Full year 2026: net sales and adjusted earnings per shareThe Company tightened its full-year 2026 net sales forecast to a range of $578.0 million to $585.0 million, from its previous range of $572.0 million to $585.0 million, up from 2025 net sales of $566.2 million. It also tightened its full-year adjusted earnings per diluted share forecast to a range of $0.60 to $0.66, from its previous range of $0.54 to $0.66, up from $0.46 in 2025 and representing 43% growth at the high end.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 9, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
